SELECT t.id AS id, t.transaction_type AS transactionType, t.created_at AS createdAt, to_a.account_id AS toAccountCode, COALESCE(from_a.account_id, bp.card_owner) AS fromAccountCode, t.amount AS amount, UPPER(c.code) AS currencyCode, t.description AS description, t.remark AS remark, t.created_by AS createdBy, FALSE AS deleted, NULL AS deletedBy, NULL AS deletedAt, bp.id AS bankProcessId, bpap.period_type AS periodType, t.transaction_date AS transactionDate FROM transactions t INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = t.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id INNER JOIN account to_a ON to_a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN account from_a ON from_a.id = t.from_account_id INNER JOIN bank_process_accounting_posted bpap ON bpap.id = t.bank_process_posted_id INNER JOIN bank_process bp ON bp.id = bpap.bank_process_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.bank_process_posted_id IS NOT NULL AND t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND bpap.outcome = 'POSTED' AND t.transaction_type IN () AND t.transaction_date >= #{dateFrom} AND t.transaction_date <= #{dateTo}
AND UPPER(c.code) IN
UPPER(#{code})
AND ( UPPER(to_a.account_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(from_a.account_id, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(bp.card_owner, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(t.description, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(t.remark, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(t.created_by, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') )
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC

AND UPPER(c.code) IN
UPPER(#{code})
AND ( UPPER(to_a.account_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(from_a.account_id, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(bp.card_owner, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(td.description, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(td.remark, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(td.created_by, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(td.deleted_by, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') )

SELECT dl.id AS id, dl.created_at AS dtsCreated, p.code AS process, dl.id_product AS idProduct, a.account_id AS account, CASE WHEN dl.product_type = 'MAIN' THEN dl.description_main ELSE dl.description_sub END AS description, dc.remark AS remark, dl.source_percent AS percent, UPPER(c.code) AS currency, dl.rate_expression AS rate, CASE WHEN dl.processed_amount >= 0 THEN dl.processed_amount ELSE NULL END AS cr, CASE WHEN dl.processed_amount < 0 THEN ABS(dl.processed_amount) ELSE NULL END AS dr, dc.created_by AS createdBy, FALSE AS deleted, NULL AS deletedBy, NULL AS deletedAt FROM data_capture_line dl INNER JOIN data_captures dc ON dc.id = dl.capture_id AND dc.tenant_id = dl.tenant_id INNER JOIN process p ON p.id = dc.process_id INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = dl.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = dl.tenant_id INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = dl.account_id WHERE dl.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dc.capture_date >= #{dateFrom} AND dc.capture_date <= #{dateTo} AND dc.category = #{category}
AND (UPPER(p.code) = UPPER(#{process}) OR CAST(p.id AS CHAR) = #{process})
AND ( UPPER(dl.id_product) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(a.account_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(dl.description_main, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(dl.description_sub, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(dc.remark, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(dc.created_by, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{q}), '%') )
ORDER BY dl.created_at DESC, dl.id DESC
